changelog:
Initial release of ai-communication-culture skill.

- Equips leaders to foster flat, participative communication cultures crucial for successful AI adoption.
- Provides the symphony conductor model to bridge technical and business teams and facilitate unified action.
- Explains the importance of democratizing data and building trust between departments.
- Offers guidance on removing bureaucratic obstacles and streamlining information flow.
- Emphasizes establishing transparent feedback loops and creating shared responsibility for AI projects.
